title: All-round visibility and easy parking
summary: Reviews mainly describe the car as a strong all-round package, with visibility, easy parking, comfort, fuel economy, and available equipment mentioned positively, while several fragments use "round" in ways that do not clearly express a topic-specific sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as a solid all-round package and specifically highlight good visibility, simple parking, comfort, fuel economy, and generous equipment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly use "all round" or "round trip" phrasing without enough detail to confirm a clear sentiment about a specific aspect.

limitations: The cluster mixes broad 'all-round' praise with specific comments about visibility and parking, so it is not fully coherent as a single aspect topic.
Several undetermined fragments use 'round' in travel-distance or general phrasing that may reflect keyword matching rather than a distinct product attribute.
Examples are brief, so there is limited detail on which exact features make the car feel 'all-round' beyond visibility, parking, comfort, fuel economy, and equipment.
